name: pi-smart-home-hub
description: Self-hosted smart home hub for Raspberry Pi: Nanoleaf, TCL TV, Xbox One S, PC, Ecobee, Ring

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run smoke
